    S3StorageAdapter - Class in edu.ai.lms.core.material.adapter.out.storage
    Facade that delegates storage operations to the appropriate S3Client: - "prod" profile → DigitalOceanConfig's S3Client - "dev" profile → LocalStorageConfig's S3Client (LocalStack) Spring automatically injects the profile-active bean; this class adds helper methods and a uniform API on top of it.
